article.headline: Parker's 29 lead Saint Francis (PA) past LIU 74-64
article.description: — Riley Parker had 29 points in Saint Francis (PA)'s 74-64 win over LIU on Friday night.
article.linkText: Parker's 29 lead Saint Francis (PA) past LIU 74-64

categories.description: Long Island University Sharks @ Saint Francis Red Flash

event.description: Long Island University Sharks @ Saint Francis Red Flash

keywords: Long Island University Sharks @ Saint Francis Red Flash
article.story: LORETTO, Penn. -- — Riley Parker had 29 points in Saint Francis (PA)'s 74-64 win over LIU on Friday night. Parker shot 9 for 14 (4 for 8 from 3-point range) and 7 of 7 from the free-throw line for the Red Flash (8-13, 3-4 Northeast Conference). Valentino Pinedo scored 12 points while going 3 of 4 and 6 of 8 from the free-throw line and added nine rebounds. Daemar Kelly shot 4 of 8 from the field and 2 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 11 points, while adding eight rebounds. Jamal Fuller finished with 25 points and nine rebounds for the Sharks (10-12, 6-1). Blake Lander added 12 points and six rebounds for LIU. Brent Davis also had nine points and four steals. The loss snapped the Sharks' six-game winning streak. These two teams both play Sunday. Saint Francis (PA) hosts Wagner and LIU visits Mercyhurst. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
